findings.title: Legacy Complete goals falsely re-fire settle-notify on any field edit
findings.description: settle_stamp falls back to updated_at_ms when completed_at_ms is None. Any tool-side update changes the stamp and re-pokes watcher.
findings.suggested_fix: Migrate legacy or use dedicated settle_completion_stamp

findings.title: Lazy elapsed-wait-barrier clear is not persisted when dirty=false
findings.description: try_claim_continuation lazy self-clear updates local goal but dirty only tracks baseline+workspace. Idle+dirty=false branch doesn't persist.
findings.suggested_fix: Widen dirty to include waiting_until_ms or always persist
